notes.title: The Game of Life 2 joins the WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
[p]Join Marmalade Game Studio in supporting Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC) for World Ocean Day – and snag a new game for less![/p][p]The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June 2025, 10am PDT. Find a selection of Marmalade classics in the sale: [/p][list][*][p]The Game of Life 2 – 60% off[/p][/*][*][p]Battleship – 80% off[/p][/*][*][p]Ticket to Ride – 60% off [/p][/*][*][p]Ticket to Ride: USA 1910 Ticket Pack – 40% off[/p][/*][*][p]Ticket to Ride: Europe Expansion – 40% off [/p][/*][*][p]Ticket to Ride: Starter Pack Bundle – 45% off[/p][/*][/list][p]We will donate 20% of our net revenue to WDC to support their conservation work, so you can have fun and change the world at the same time![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://bit.ly/WODSale25" style="button"]Go to the WDC Sale Page here[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Who are WDC?[/b][/p][p]WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. [/p][p]Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together and work hand-in-hand with businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.[/p][p]Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic beings. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.
[/p][p][b]What is ghost gear?[/b][/p][p]Ghost gear is fishing gear that has been lost or abandoned at sea. It’s a deadly menace to whales, dolphins and other marine life. [/p][p]But it’s difficult and expensive for fishers and other ocean users to dispose of gear they find at sea, or even to responsibly get rid of their own gear at the end of its life.[/p][p]It is a massive problem, and so WDC are working on innovative solutions.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]How your support will help this year[/b][/p][p]By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabed and shipwrecks in UK seas.[/p][p]If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: [/p][p][url="https://whales.org/"]https://whales.org/[/url]
[/p][p][i]*20% of our net revenue from this sale (after Steam platform fees) will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Meet Titan and Rebel - our adventurous heroes!
notes.content:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695460/The_Game_of_Life_2__Superhero_World/]Superhero World[/url] is out now, full of choices and possibilities,[b] and now it's your turn to influence its narrative! 🦸[/b]

Now that you’re familiar with Chronos and Melodia, (if you’re not, what are you waiting for to read our previous announcement?) it’s time for you to meet Titan and Rebel!

Don’t forget what’s your mission here! ➡️ [b]Vote for your favourite!⚡[/b]

[h3]The winner superhero will be featured as a free outfit FREE for all players! [/h3]

[b]The vote is happening [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]here[/url]! [/b]

[h3][b]Meet Titan - The Armored Guardian[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/0abc4ebdf03931c1f10a1d31a9fc05d3f75e66b5.png[/img]

They are strong and assertive, always focused on protecting the Superhero World from any danger. With their crazy wealth – earned through their smart investments – they've got access to top-notch materials, crafting the most powerful armour that the Superhero World has ever seen. Somehow, he keeps getting richer, and his armour keeps getting better!

But here's a hidden secret: Titan, this mighty defender, capable of making split-second choices in dangerous situations, struggles with the most trivial choices in their personal life. When picking between two flavours of ice cream or which movie to watch, they freeze. Literally. In battle, you can’t defeat them with strength, no matter how powerful you are.

But hey, everyone still loves them! How could you not? 

[h3][b]Meet Rebel - The Mindweaver[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/4db0c73f07070676bdb43fcd33606c2baed1c459.png[/img]

Rebel is the anti-norm superhero we never knew we needed. They don't play by the rules; they use the power of mind control to take on the world's injustices. They can sneak into people's minds and alter their actions, leaving those around them with a temporary altered judgement, thanks to the lingering effects of their controlling aura.

But here's the twist – every time they unleash their powers on others, they end up getting hit by their own actions. This self-inflicted mind-control messes with their own decision-making for a limited time, and suddenly, they're either on a winning streak or stuck in a streak of bad luck. This turns their interactions into a rollercoaster of unpredictability, making every outcome a spin of the wheel, whether it's incredibly lucky or just downright unfortunate! 

At the end of the day, they sacrifice themselves for the better of the Superhero World. What can be more heroic than that?!

[b]➡️ Now their fate is in your hands! If you want to have a FREE Titan or Rebel outfit, [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]vote [/url]for them now! [/b]

notes.title: Meet Chronos and Melodia - our tenacious heroes!
notes.content:
Exciting news! With the launch of The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695460/The_Game_of_Life_2__Superhero_World/]Superhero World[/url] it's time for you to unleash your inner superhero and [b]vote for the hero you want to embody to conquer this amazing world[/b]. There are 4 incredible superheroes for you to choose from: Chronos, Melodia, Titan, and Rebel. [b]Your mission? Vote for your favourite!⚡[/b]

[h3]The winning superhero will become available for FREE to all players![/h3]

Have your say [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]here[/url]!

But first, meet your first two superheroes 🦸

[h3][b]Chronos - The Temporal Maestro[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/d003f4c5afd636177a2c921cdd1e40d4cc03584d.png[/img]

Chronos isn't just your regular superhero, they've got this rare gem on their forehead called Tick-Tock Crystal. This ancient stone not only makes them look legendary but also gives them the power to fly and control time and quantum woo. When it's time to fight, they tune their mind into the crystal's powers and can see the future, make smart moves and gain special knowledge.

But here's the twist – those visions? They're not always in sync with reality. As Chronos plays around with time, things get a bit goofy. The gap between what they see coming and what actually goes down leads to some seriously unexpected consequences!

[h3][b]Melodia - The Sound Enchantress[/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/9e1f208ff19bd350e4684663da28a12436751be6.png[/img]

Melodia is basically on a mission to battling bad guys armed with nothing but kindness. With the power of positivity, they can craft melodies that make others suddenly want to break into a happy dance or become overly generous with gifts and assistance. Their vibes are so strong, even the toughest villains can't help but be enchanted by it!

But, here's the punchline— the powers are like a superhero one-hit wonder, catchy… but temporary. And to add a sprinkle of chaos, there's a cooldown period. During it, they can get a bit slow and might find themselves stuck in the less action-packed corners of the world for a while. It's like their powers need a little nap after all that positivity spreading. 

But hey, even in the midst of the chaos, our hero manages to bring a smile to everyone's face. Who knew fighting crime could be this groovy?


[b]➡️Now, their fate is in your hands! Do you want to play as the enchantress Melodia or the powerful Chronos? [url=https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/superheroworld-new-outfit/]Cast your vote now![/url][/b]

notes.title: The Game of Life 2: A Guide to Adorable Wildlife in Every World
notes.content:
It has been three years since The Game of Life 2 video board game was launched. In that time nine worlds have been released, bringing lifetimes of dreams and adventures to players around the globe. From the depths of the ocean to the dark side of the moon, peg-life journeys from first independent decisions to retirement and beyond.

Every Game of Life 2 world is packed with adorable details and animal life is central to every one. But which creature is the team favourite? We looked at the data:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465430/The_Game_of_Life_2__Fairytale_Kingdom_world//]Fairytale Kingdom[/url]:
Everywhere else, dragons are nothing but a myth, but in this fantasy realm they are more common than cats!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465431/The_Game_of_Life_2__Haunted_Hills_world//]Haunted Hills[/url]:
In a world made for cosy spooky fun, it is perhaps unsurprising that the bat is the most common sight.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1544410/The_Game_of_Life_2__Age_of_Giants_world/
/]Age of Giants[/url]:
Peg-life reaches new heights in prehistoric times, where dino-dentist is a real career path, but it’s the pterodactyl that outnumbers the rest!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/57899bca635a88c867fadf62b0df05279e892540.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465432/The_Game_of_Life_2__Frozen_Lands_world//]Frozen Lands[/url]:
Despite living alongside Polar Bears in this fantasy world, penguin numbers remain stable and outnumber all other species!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803670/The_Game_of_Life_2__Lunar_Age///]Lunar Age[/url]:
Exploration of the moon is ongoing as pegs journey from Moon Base to Advanced Alien Civilisation. But as yet, no animals have been found!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065660/The_Game_of_Life_2__Sweet_Haven_world/
/]Sweet Haven[/url]:
It would take a highly specialist animal to survive on an island floating in candied sugar-clouds. As a result, robo-pigeons have been specifically crafted by the locals.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/75528eaf70df47aef29875a346f4b8ce017fc529.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627910/The_Game_of_Life_2__Sandy_Shores_world//]Sandy Shores[/url]:
Where there is one parakeet, there are many, and in the Sandy Shores world parakeets easily outnumber all other animals.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218810/The_Game_of_Life_2__Under_the_Sea//]Under the Sea[/url]:
There may be plenty of fish, rays and whales, but the most common creature beneath the surface is the jellyfish.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485880/The_Game_of_Life_2__El_Dorado//]El Dorado[/url]:
Journey into the jungle, step over twisted roots, crumbling ruins and glittering streams, and you are very likely to see a capybara!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39156327/36eac46a72a5b78b8082516a1197a34d18c42635.png[/img]

There are more species than this in every world, and more to discover every time you play! Live lifetimes in every one and you may just see them all!

Discover all 9 worlds now in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461050/The_Game_of_Life_2__The_Ultimate_Life_Collection//]The Ultimate Life Collection[/url], available for cross-platform multiplayer on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox and mobile.
